result.summary: Kestrel Marine Parts Ltd currently has one open overdue invoice of $70,000 at 38 days past due (original due 2026-10-16), against a single TCI policy with a $500k limit (total exposure $165k, well within limit). The prior overdue (Jul-2026) resolved in 12 days, so the time-to-resolve has roughly tripled, and notification frequency has risen from 0 to 2 in the last 180 days (single policy), indicating emerging payment friction worth monitoring.
concerns: Days-to-resolve on overdues increased from 12 to 38+ days (still open)
Notification count rose from 0 to 2 in the trailing 6 months, suggesting payment pattern is deteriorating
Only one policyholder/policy reporting so far - limited diversification to confirm systemic issue, but worth watching for spread to other policies
